recentItems.description:

In an update to a 2021 video (of 2020 recordings), here is an updated look at the legal IDs of the broadcast radio stations in the area of Harrisburg, Lancaster, and York, Pennsylvania.

This update is a mix of stream and local over-the-air recordings from near the stations areas. OTA recordings will be noted in the bottom right corner of the video. Radio used is a Sangean HDR-14 connected to an audio recorder.

Most recordings are from March 2026 with the exception of two from mid-January (WADV, whose automation makes the time that IDs air really unpredictable; and WQLV, who was sold to become WCDF in February.)

recentItems.title: WLYC 1050 / WHLM 930 -  Flip to Classic Rock "The GOAT 102-104-107" (10/1/25)
recentItems.description:
Here is this morning's flip and first hour from WLYC 1050 in Williamsport and WHLM 930 in Bloomsburg.

Former Bigfoot Legends Williamsport simulcaster WLYC was paired with former Pop Radio Bloomsburg simulcaster WHLM to form 7MM's newest GOAT branded Classic Rock station. Bigfoot Legends continues on WEJS 1600, while WBWX 1280 was flipped to Classic Hits joining WHNA 92.3 and WNNA 106.1 as part of Hanna Radio.

Recording Date: October 1st, 2025
Recording Time (Eastern): 9:55-11:05 AM

recentItems.title: WHLM Bloomsburg, PA / WBWX Berwick, PA / WLYC Williamsport, PA Legal ID (STUNTING)(9/27/25)
recentItems.description:
ID at 2:35

At some point this weekend, the former Bloomsburg Pop Radio duo, plus WLYC from the Bigfoot Country Legends Williamsport simulcast, began stunting with the 7MM stunting classic, 'Changes' by David Bowie, intermixed with farm sound effects and an announcer. A new format is being teased to launch Wednesday 10/1 at 10am.

Legal ID, plus some of the stunting montage, from:
WHLM 930 in Bloomsburg, Pennsylvania, WBWX 1280 in Berwick, Pennsylvania, and WLYC 1050 in Williamsport, Pennsylvania, plus translators W234BH 94.7 Berwick, W242CY 96.3 Berwick, W272ED New Columbia, W282CO 104.3 Bloomsburg, W288CF 105.5 Danville, W296CD 107.1 Jonestown

recentItems.title: Format Swap: WRXR-FM "Rock 105" to WKXJ "105.5 Kiss Chattanooga" (5/23/25)
recentItems.description:
Part two of airchecks from Friday's Audacy Chattanooga format swap. This aircheck cover's 105.5's last hour as WRXR-FM "Rock 105" and first hour as WKXJ "105.5 Kiss Chattanooga".

WRXR's last hour on 105.5 was DJ'd by local midday host/brand manager Greg Rambin (known on-air as just Rambin.) The final portion of the hour was a replay of the first ever song played when the format launched in 1999. That segment begins at 7:17 in the video.

The switchover happens at 8:17.

WKXJ's first hour was without a host, their only local host remains in the 3-7 pm shift. A launch piece airs within the hour... 3 times.

Recording Date: May 23rd, 2025
Recording Time (Eastern): 11:00 AM - 1:00 PM

recentItems.title: Format Swap: WKXJ "103.7 Kiss FM" to WRXR-FM "Rock 103.7" (5/23/25)
recentItems.description:
Part one of two of airchecks from Friday's Audacy Chattanooga format swap. This aircheck cover's 103.7's last hour as WKXJ "103.7 Kiss FM" and first hour as WRXR-FM "Rock 103.7".

WKXJ's final hour was on Audacy's "The Julia Show", heard on many of their CHR stations nationwide. Only one brief promo aired making a brief mention of upcoming moves.

After about three and a half minutes of (mostly) dead air, WRXR-FM local midday host/brand manager Greg Rambin launches the new brand with a 15 minute intro, featuring tributes to former station brand manager Randy "Boner" Smith, who passed away in November 2023. If you want to hear the full segment unedited with songs in full, you can hear it here: https://youtu.be/ZtL_7WAi-us

The switchover begins at 5:35

Recording Date: May 23rd, 2025
Recording Time (Eastern): 11:00 AM - 1:00 PM
